name: CEO Salesperson Performance
query:
SELECT
    u.name AS "Salesperson ID",
    u.full_name AS "Salesperson",

    COALESCE(d.total_deals, 0) AS "Total Deals",
    COALESCE(d.won_deals, 0) AS "Won Deals",
    COALESCE(d.lost_deals, 0) AS "Lost Deals",

    COALESCE(d.won_revenue, 0) AS "Won Revenue",
    COALESCE(d.pipeline_value, 0) AS "Pipeline Value",

    COALESCE(t.target_amount, 0) AS "Sales Target",
    COALESCE(t.achieved_amount, 0) AS "Achieved Amount",

    GREATEST(
        COALESCE(t.target_amount, 0) -
        COALESCE(t.achieved_amount, 0), 0
    ) AS "Remaining Target",

    COALESCE(t.achievement_percentage, 0)
        AS "Achievement Percentage",

    COALESCE(t.target_status, 'Not Started')
        AS "Target Status"

FROM `tabUser` u

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        deal_owner,

        SUM(CASE
            WHEN DATE(creation) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS total_deals,

        SUM(CASE
            WHEN status = 'Won'
            AND closed_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS won_deals,

        SUM(CASE
            WHEN status = 'Lost'
            AND closed_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS lost_deals,

        SUM(CASE
            WHEN status = 'Won'
            AND closed_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
            THEN deal_value ELSE 0
        END) AS won_revenue,

        SUM(CASE
            WHEN status NOT IN ('Won', 'Lost')
            THEN expected_deal_value ELSE 0
        END) AS pipeline_value

    FROM `tabCRM Deal`
    WHERE deal_owner IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY deal_owner
) d ON d.deal_owner = u.name

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        salesperson,
        SUM(target_amount) AS target_amount,
        SUM(achieved_amount) AS achieved_amount,

        CASE
            WHEN SUM(target_amount) > 0
            THEN ROUND(
                SUM(achieved_amount) / SUM(target_amount) * 100, 2
            )
            ELSE 0
        END AS achievement_percentage,

        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT target_status
            ORDER BY target_status
            SEPARATOR ', '
        ) AS target_status

    FROM `tabSales Target`
    WHERE target_type = 'Individual'
    AND start_date >= %(from_date)s
    AND end_date <= %(to_date)s
    GROUP BY salesperson
) t ON t.salesperson = u.name

WHERE u.enabled = 1
AND u.name NOT IN ('Administrator', 'Guest')

AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM `tabHas Role` hr
    WHERE hr.parent = u.name
    AND hr.parenttype = 'User'
    AND hr.role = 'CRM Salesperson'
)

ORDER BY "Won Revenue" DESC
